title: Zach Bryan Sets His ‘Manhood’ Tour for 2027
summary: The outing will hit 19 stadiums on two continents starting in April.
contentText:
Zach Bryan will hit the road in 2027 for his Young Manhood and Other Donatable Organs tour.

The tour takes its name from Bryan’s EP that comes out Friday (Oct. 16) on Warner Records. The eight-song collection includes collaborations with Lana Del Rey and Turnpike Troubadours.

The AEG Presents outing will travel across 19 stadiums for 23 dates in North America and Australia starting April 28 at Minneapolis’ U.S. Bank Stadium before concluding Dec. 18 at Brisbane’s Suncorp Stadium.

Bryan has a wide array of opening acts ranging from Rock & Roll Hall of Famer John Fogerty to newcomer Emma Ogier. Also hitting the road with Bryan will be Ryan Bingham and the Texas Gentlemen, Vance Joy, Fey Fili and Gabriella Rose.

Bryan is a touring powerhouse. On Billboard’s 2025 year-end Boxscore Top Tours chart, Bryan ranked No. 13 globally with $159.6 million in gross revenue from 941,000 tickets sold.
